events.text: Surveyed the active PaintSidePanel successor: the shader page keeps all 48 visible cells, but each ShaderThumb is a live Effect. effects.paintCustomEffect renders each one into its own GPU target every paint frame. The planned fix uses the existing StaticSurface paint cache around the complete interactive grid plus value-stable thumbnail memoization; layout, hit testing, tooltips, paging, and visible count remain unchanged.

resolution: Optimized the active Paint shader browser without reducing its fixed 8x6, 48-material display. The interactive grid now captures once through StaticSurface and composites as one quad instead of repainting 48 live Effects every frame; ShaderThumb value memoization prevents fresh-but-equal data arrays from invalidating the cache, while search, paging, selection, variants, and palette changes still recapture. Added focused tests and updated the game knowledge record; the ReleaseFast editor ship passes. User review should hold this panel open for 60 seconds and confirm FPS plus spikewatch behavior.
